# `mise generate git-pre-commit`

- **用法：** `mise generate git-pre-commit [FLAGS] [-- MISE_ARG]…`
- **别名：** `pre-commit`
- **效果：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/generate/git_pre_commit.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/generate/git_pre_commit.rs)

Generate a git hook that runs a mise task

The hook runs `mise run <TASK>` (default `pre-commit`) with the staged file names
in the STAGED environment variable. It prints the hook unless you pass --write,
which saves it in the repository's hooks directory and makes it executable.

For hooks that git gives a message file (commit-msg, prepare-commit-msg,
applypatch-msg, sendemail-validate), the task gets that file as an argument.
Other hook arguments, such as a pre-push hook's remote name and URL, are not
passed on.

For a full git hook manager, see hk: <https://hk.jdx.dev>

## 参数
- **`[-- MISE_ARG]…`** — 要嵌入生成的钩子中的 mise 标志，写在 `--` 之后

  这些参数会插入到 `mise` 和 `run` 之间，因此钩子会携带你在命令行中传递的相同上下文。当配置文件不在仓库根目录时很有用，因为 git 会从顶层目录运行钩子：`-- -C subdir` 会让钩子找到它。

## Flags
- **`-t --task <TASK>`** — The task to run when the hook is triggered

  **Default:** `pre-commit`
- **`-w --write`** — Write the hook to the hooks directory and make it executable

  The hooks directory is `.git/hooks`, or `core.hooksPath` when it is set. An existing hook of the same name is moved to `<HOOK>.old`.
- **`--hook <HOOK>`** — Which git hook to write, such as pre-push

  **默认值：** `pre-commit`
- **`-h --help`** — 打印帮助

## 示例

Install the hook; each commit then runs `mise run pre-commit`

```
mise generate git-pre-commit --write --task=pre-commit
```

Use the config in subdir, since git runs hooks from the repository root

```
mise generate git-pre-commit --write -- -C subdir
```
